error_value_contract: Every ERROR wire value is a stable <domain>:<reason> code.
file_rule: lstat without following links; absent file is VALUE <file-absent> FAIL; not a regular file is ERROR auditd-conf:invalid-type; owner other than uid 0 or group/other write is ERROR auditd-conf:untrusted; NUL bytes, a missing final newline or a line longer than 158 bytes is ERROR
key_rule: one control per key; only lines of the control's own key are interpreted
line_rule: as auditd nv_split: tokens separated by spaces only, repeated spaces skipped; a first token starting with # is a comment; the key name is compared case-insensitively; a key line must be exactly key = value with at most one more token (option), otherwise ERROR auditd-conf:invalid-line; a first token key=... without spaces is ERROR auditd-conf:invalid-line
source_rule: fstec-logging-2025 appendix 2 item 3 requires configuring /etc/audit/auditd.conf and names max_log_file, num_logs, log_file and log_group without values; by user decision 30.09.2026 (variant B, auditd segmentation map v5) nine keys with company-policy values are one control each
value_rule: no active key line is VALUE <absent> FAIL; more than one is VALUE <duplicate> FAIL; one line: VALUE is the value (and option, if any); PASS only without option and when max_log_file and num_logs are digits equal by number, max_log_file_action, log_format, space_left_action, admin_space_left_action and disk_full_action equal case-insensitively, log_file and log_group equal byte for byte; a value or option outside printable ASCII is ERROR auditd-conf:invalid-value
